name: Outline
short_desc: A fast, collaborative knowledge base for your team.
author: outline
description: Outline is a self-hosted knowledge base and wiki, a solid alternative to Notion or Confluence. This bundle ships Outline itself plus PostgreSQL, Redis, a small built-in OIDC provider for login, and an nginx reverse proxy that serves both on a single origin. Outline has no local account signup, so the bundled OIDC provider supplies the sign-in flow: you set a username and password at install time. Because Outline builds absolute URLs and OIDC callbacks from its configured domain, this app must be exposed on its own domain over HTTPS.

form_fields.label: Username
form_fields.hint: The username for your first Outline account. You sign in with it through the bundled OIDC provider.

form_fields.label: Password
form_fields.hint: Password for the account above. Choose something strong: this login is reachable from wherever you expose the app.

form_fields.label: Outline secret key
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated. Signs sessions. Leave as generated.

form_fields.label: Database password
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated PostgreSQL password. Leave as generated.

form_fields.label: OIDC provider secret
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated. Django secret key for the bundled OIDC provider. Leave as generated.
